title: Zesty Garlicky Slovakian Potato Casserole
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring caramelized potatoes and garlic in a rich buttery sauce, served in a cazuela vessel.
instructions: In a large skillet, caramelize the sliced potatoes over medium heat for 20 minutes.
In a separate skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour and vegetable broth until smooth.
In a large cazuela vessel, create a layer of potatoes, followed by a layer of the onion and garlic mixture, and then a layer of the flour and broth mixture.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of potatoes on top.
Dot the top of the potatoes with the melted butter.
Cover the cazuela with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
